offering_description.value: Operates accredited for-profit universities offering certificate, associate, bachelor's, master's and doctoral degree programs to adult students, mainly online. Programs are delivered through its universities, including Colorado Technical University and American InterContinental University, plus the University of St. Augustine for Health Sciences.

primary_services.value: online degree programs; campus-based degree programs; health sciences graduate education; business and technology education; culinary arts education

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual adult students enrolling in degree programs, often funded by federal student aid or loans

end_markets.value: postsecondary education; healthcare education; business and information technology education; culinary and beauty education

revenue_model.value: service fees: tuition and fees paid by students, largely funded by federal Title IV financial aid

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates accredited universities delivering instruction to students, mostly online

geography_served.value: US national: Online students across the US, with campuses in several states such as Colorado, Illinois, Texas, Florida and California

specialization.value: related lines: Colorado Technical University, American InterContinental University, University of St. Augustine for Health Sciences and culinary programs

distribution_channels.value: online: online learning platforms and web-based enrollment; own locations: university campuses and instructional sites

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Title IV federal student aid eligibility, Department of Education rules, accreditors, state authorization and consumer protection oversight
